seo_meta_how_it_works_description: See how LocalSnow works: search freely and contact instructors yourself, or choose guaranteed booking when you want LocalSnow to secure a suitable lesson or refund you.
how_it_works_page_intro: LocalSnow gives clients two routes: a free self-managed inquiry when you want to coordinate yourself, and guaranteed booking when you want LocalSnow to secure a suitable lesson or refund you.
how_it_works_page_clients_step1_desc: Choose your resort and sport to see instructors and schools in that area.
how_it_works_page_clients_step2_desc: Review certifications, languages, specialties, and pricing. Verified badges highlight trusted pros.
how_it_works_page_clients_step3_desc: Use the profile form to share your dates, group size, and goals.
how_it_works_page_clients_step3_note: Free inquiries are self-managed and not guaranteed. Guaranteed booking is the safer route when you want LocalSnow to secure the lesson.
how_it_works_page_clients_step4_desc: If you want to avoid chasing messages, uncertain availability, or finding a replacement yourself, choose guaranteed booking.
how_it_works_page_clients_step5_desc: On the free route, you coordinate schedule, meeting point, price, and payment yourself. On the guaranteed route, LocalSnow secures a suitable lesson for your group or refunds you if we cannot make it happen.
how_it_works_page_clients_step6_desc: After your lesson, leave a review to help others choose confidently.

how_it_works_page_instructors_step2_desc: Publish your profile when you're ready. Verification adds a trusted badge for clients and schools.
how_it_works_page_instructors_step3_desc: Clients and schools can contact you through your profile. You'll get an email with their message.
how_it_works_page_instructors_step4_desc: Discuss availability, lesson details, and meeting points over email or phone.
how_it_works_page_instructors_step4_note: No lead fees to view contact details.
how_it_works_page_instructors_step5_desc: Set dates, price, and terms on your schedule. Ideal for referrals and overflow.
how_it_works_page_instructors_step6_desc: Get paid by the client using your preferred method. LocalSnow charges a fair commission only on confirmed protected bookings — free inquiries and direct arrangements have no fee.
how_it_works_page_instructors_step6_note: Self-managed inquiries are free for instructors. A fair commission applies when LocalSnow confirms a protected booking on your behalf.
how_it_works_page_instructors_cost_lead: No lead fees - contact details included
how_it_works_page_instructors_cost_no_co: Fair commission only when LocalSnow confirms a protected booking for you
how_it_works_page_faq_deposit_q: Is this a booking platform or a directory?
how_it_works_page_faq_deposit_a: Both routes exist. Free inquiry lets you find instructors and coordinate everything yourself. Guaranteed booking is the recommended paid route when you want LocalSnow to secure a suitable lesson through its snowsports know-how and trusted network.
how_it_works_page_faq_lead_fee_q: Can schools list profiles and invite instructors?
how_it_works_page_faq_lead_fee_a: Yes. Schools can create profiles, invite instructors, and use the directory for referrals and overflow.
how_it_works_page_faq_payments_a: On the free route, you pay the instructor directly and handle the details yourself. On the guaranteed route, you pay LocalSnow for a suitable lesson: if we cannot secure the requested lesson or an acceptable alternative, you get a refund.
how_it_works_page_faq_no_response_q: What if an instructor doesn't respond?
how_it_works_page_faq_no_response_a: On the free route, you try another instructor yourself because availability changes quickly. On the guaranteed route, LocalSnow keeps the outcome in focus: a suitable lesson for your group, a suitable alternative, or a refund.
how_it_works_page_faq_contact_q: How do I contact an instructor?
how_it_works_page_faq_contact_a: Use the contact form on their profile with your dates and details. The instructor replies directly.

about_meta_description: Local Snow is built by a ski instructor with experience across Argentina, New Zealand, Spain, and Chile. It helps clients find credible snowsports professionals and choose between self-managed inquiry or guaranteed booking.
about_who_built_p1: I'm a ski instructor. I've worked across different continents, resort cultures, and business models. That perspective showed me a clear opportunity: improve how clients, instructors, and schools find each other and work together.
about_economic_p1: Ski schools and booking platforms are important parts of snowsports. The challenge is that compensation models vary a lot, and in some markets instructors receive a much smaller share of lesson revenue than clients expect.
about_economic_p2: In some setups, lessons are priced per student while instructor pay stays flat. For example, a group of 6 paying €60/hour each is €360/hour total, while the instructor might still earn around €25/hour. That gap is one reason many instructors look for additional ways to build sustainable income.
about_economic_p3: Some booking platforms also add large commissions and software fees for basic tools like calendars and pricing. Local Snow separates free self-managed inquiries from fair commission only when LocalSnow brings and confirms protected bookings.
about_visibility_p1: In many booking journeys, clients see the school brand first and the instructor details later. But lessons depend on trust and safety, especially with children. Clients should be able to review credentials and choose with full information.
about_visibility_p2: Transparent instructor profiles help everyone: clients choose confidently, instructors build reputation, and schools can showcase the quality of their teams.
about_risk_p1: Being a ski instructor comes with real risks. Physical injury, liability exposure, unpredictable income, seasonal uncertainty. We take on all of that, and yet most of us can't make a comfortable living from it. That's not sustainable, and it's not fair.
about_risk_p2: Instructors need tools that help them manage their business, own their client relationships, and earn what they're worth—without sacrificing half their income to middlemen.
about_what_is_p1: Local Snow is a snowsports lesson platform where instructors and schools publish transparent profiles, clients can send free self-managed inquiries, and guaranteed booking gives clients a suitable lesson or refund if LocalSnow cannot make it happen.
about_what_is_p2: Local Snow is built for both independents and schools. Schools can join, publish their profile, present their instructor team, and receive direct enquiries. Independent instructors can do the same through their own profile. The goal is better discovery and fairer access for everyone.
about_what_is_p3: This isn't independents versus schools. It's one shared directory that helps schools, instructors, and clients connect more efficiently.
about_verification_p1: Every instructor who applies for verification is reviewed through certifications, qualifications, and professional credentials. The badge does not mean someone is the best instructor in the world—it confirms they are legitimate, qualified, and take their work seriously.
about_verification_p2: Clients deserve to know who they're working with. Instructors deserve to be recognized for their qualifications. That's what verification is for.
about_spain_p1: I've worked here. I know the resorts, the instructors, the local dynamics. Starting focused made more sense than trying to build a worldwide directory on day one. If this works in Spain and helps instructors make a better living while giving clients better access to great instruction, maybe it expands. If not, at least I tried.
about_goal_p1: I want independent instructors, school-affiliated instructors, and schools to have affordable tools and clear visibility. I want clients to connect with the right professional or team. I want the snowsports industry to support sustainable careers and high-quality instruction.
about_goal_p2: This isn't about building a hype startup. It's about improving a system many people in this industry depend on. If Local Snow helps instructors and schools get discovered more fairly, and helps clients find better instruction, it's doing its job.
about_contact_p1: If you're an instructor or school owner/admin, {createProfile} here. If you have feedback or questions, email me at {email}.
about_contact_p2: That's it. No manifesto, no corporate mission statement. Just trying to do better.
about_intro: Local Snow is a free directory connecting clients with independent ski and snowboard instructors worldwide.
about_mission_text: We believe ski lessons should be easier to find and safer to arrange. Instructors set their own prices, self-managed inquiries stay free, and LocalSnow earns fairly only when it brings and confirms protected work.
about_how_different_text: Unlike generic booking platforms, LocalSnow keeps discovery lightweight while adding a guaranteed booking path for clients who want confidence that the lesson need will be solved.
about_story_text: Founded by a working ski instructor who was frustrated with expensive booking platforms that take large cuts from every lesson.

how_works_faq_really_free_a: Yes. Searching profiles and sending a self-managed inquiry is free. Guaranteed booking is the paid route when you want LocalSnow to secure a suitable lesson or refund you.
how_works_faq_how_money_q: How do you make money if the directory is free?
how_works_faq_how_money_a: Currently, we don't. LocalSnow is community-driven. In the future, we may explore optional premium features or ads, but the core directory will always remain free. We're building the directory we wish existed—not maximizing profit.
how_works_faq_instructors_pay_q: Do instructors pay to be listed or receive requests?
how_works_faq_instructors_pay_a: Profiles and free direct inquiries do not have lead fees. A fair commission applies only when LocalSnow brings and secures a protected booking for you.
how_works_faq_students_pay_q: How do students pay for lessons?
how_works_faq_students_pay_a: On the free inquiry path, you arrange payment and details directly with the instructor. On the guaranteed path, you pay LocalSnow for a suitable lesson; if we cannot secure one or an acceptable alternative, you get a refund.
how_works_faq_no_response_q: What if an instructor doesn't respond to my request?
how_works_faq_no_response_a: On the free path, try another instructor if your first choice does not respond. If you want LocalSnow to handle availability, alternatives, and the final outcome, choose guaranteed booking where available.
how_works_faq_safe_a: We verify instructor certifications when possible, but ultimately you're responsible for vetting your instructor. Read reviews in their directory profile, ask for credentials, and trust your instincts. Since we don't process payments, there's no financial risk using our directory.

home_faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about finding ski and snowboard instructors
home_faq_q1: How do I find a ski instructor at my resort?
home_faq_a1: Use our search to select your resort and preferred sport. Browse instructor profiles showing certifications, languages, specialties, and rates. Send a lesson request directly to the instructors you're interested in.
home_faq_q2: Is it free to search for ski instructors?
home_faq_a2: Browsing instructor profiles and sending a self-managed lesson inquiry is free. You pay only if you choose a protected booking, where LocalSnow confirms the lesson, arranges a suitable alternative, or refunds you.
home_faq_q3: What's the difference between a private ski instructor and a ski school?
home_faq_a3: Private instructors offer personalized, one-on-one or small group lessons tailored to your pace and goals. Ski schools typically offer structured group lessons at fixed times. Private instruction is often more flexible and personal—you communicate directly with your instructor.
home_faq_q4: How do I know if an instructor is qualified?
home_faq_a4: All instructors on LocalSnow list their certifications (ISIA, BASI, CSIA, ESS, or equivalent). Look for the verified badge on profiles where we've confirmed credentials. We recommend asking instructors directly about their qualifications before booking.
home_faq_q5: Can I find English-speaking ski instructors?
home_faq_a5: Yes. Use the language filter to find instructors who teach in English, Spanish, French, German, or other languages. Many instructors are multilingual and happy to teach in your preferred language.
home_faq_q6: How much does a private ski instructor cost?
home_faq_a6: Private ski instructor rates vary by resort, experience, and lesson length. You can see each instructor's rates on their profile. Because there's no platform commission, instructors often offer better rates than booking through traditional platforms.
home_faq_q7: Are there ski instructors for beginners?
home_faq_a7: Absolutely. Many instructors specialize in beginner lessons, including adults learning for the first time. Filter by specialty to find instructors experienced with beginners, kids, or specific skill levels.
home_faq_q8: Can I find ski instructors for my kids?
home_faq_a8: Yes. Search for instructors who specialize in children's ski lessons. Look for instructors with experience teaching kids and relevant certifications. You can contact them directly to discuss your child's age and experience level.
home_faq_q9: How do I contact an instructor?
home_faq_a9: Click on any instructor profile and use the contact form to send a lesson request. Include your dates, skill level, and any specific goals. The instructor will respond directly to your email.
home_faq_q10: Is LocalSnow free for ski instructors?
home_faq_a10: Instructors create and maintain profiles for free. When LocalSnow brings you a confirmed protected booking, a fair commission applies. Free discovery and self-managed inquiries have no fee.
home_faq_q11: How do I list my ski school on LocalSnow?
home_faq_a11: Sign up for a free school account and create your school profile. Add your instructors, services, and contact information. Students searching your resort will be able to find your school and contact you directly.
home_faq_a12: We cover 150+ ski resorts across Europe, North America, South America, and Asia—including popular destinations in France, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Italy, Canada, the USA, and Japan. If your resort isn't listed, you can request to add it.
home_why_free_problem_desc_v2: Booking platforms often add large commissions. Instructors earn less, students pay more, and the client still needs a lesson that actually happens.
home_why_free_solution_desc_v2: LocalSnow is free for discovery and direct inquiry. Guaranteed booking is the paid route when clients want LocalSnow to secure a suitable lesson or refund them.
home_why_free_commitment_desc: Discovery and self-managed inquiries stay free. Guaranteed booking is different: you pay when you want LocalSnow to secure a suitable lesson through its snowsports know-how and trusted network, or refund you if we cannot make it happen.
